reviews.review:
Total score 8,2 out of 10

Game Visuals and Artwork 9
Game Sound and Music 8
Core Loop And Gameplay 9
Character Design and story 7
Technical Aspect/Friendly user interface 7
Longevity And Replayability 9
Fun and Overall Feeling 10

Game Visuals and Artwork 9
Helldivers 2 looks great. The enemies are unique and easy to spot, even in the middle of chaotic battles. Their animations are well done and feel just right for each type. There’s a nice variety of worlds and environments to fight in, and each one brings its own vibe to the experience. The bombs and rockets you drop look awesome and sometimes give the whole thing a cool, almost cinematic feel.

Game Sound and Music 8
That soundtrack when you drop into a mission is seriously awesome, it really sets the tone for democracy. The rest of the music fits the game well and keeps things feeling intense. Gun sounds and enemy audio are well designed, making everything feel punchy and satisfying. There’s some ingame banter here and there, but nothing particularly stand out on that front. 

Core Loop And Gameplay 9
Helldivers 2 is a live service game, so where you go and who you fight depends on what the developers are focusing on at the time. The core loop is simple but effective, complete missions, collect cash and samples, upgrade your ship and loadout, then jump back in. Higher difficulties reward you with more cash and rarer samples, if you manage to extract in time.

The game uses a battle pass system, where the first two passes you can max out on your own. After that, you need to purchase additional passes to unlock new weapons, stratagems, or armor, each supporting a different combat style.

Each mission has a main objective, along with optional side objectives. Your performance affects the rewards you earn, and difficulty acts as a multiplier. You can play in a squad of up to four players, either with friends or through matchmaking. There’s a good variety of missions and objectives, which helps keep things fresh and prevents the gameplay from getting stale. Currently, there are no PvP options

Character Design and story 6
The story is pretty straightforward: we’re good, they’re bad, and the goal is simple ,kill them all. There’s a funny satire element that made me chuckle now and then, but there’s no real depth or memorable characters here. The point is you’re not supposed to question it ,just go out and be a Helldiver. You can swap out armor and change some weapon colors, but there’s not much customization beyond that.

Technical Aspect/Friendly user interface 7
There are some dropouts here and there, and the game has hard-crashed on me a few times, which is pretty disappointing. The UI works well though ,menus are simple and straightforward, probably because of the crossplay feature, which you can toggle on or off. There are a few in-game glitches, but overall, the game runs smoothly most of the time. 

Longevity And Replayability 9
If you like the game, it can easily keep you busy for 50+ hours. Like I mentioned before, since it’s a live service, the game is constantly changing to keep things fresh. Trying out new weapons, finding your own playstyle, and pushing the difficulty to the max all help make the gameplay last a good while.

Fun and Overall Feeling 10
Helldivers 2 is mighty fun! It delivers intense and often hilarious moments, and for its genre, it's easily one of the best out there. It's hard not to have a good time while spreading democracy across the galaxy. That said, the game can lose a bit of steam after a while, personally, I usually need a break after 2–4 rounds. It’s not without its flaws either. There are still some technical issues, like problems joining squads and the occasional disconnect. But overall, it’s a blast to play. I even went the extra mile and got 100% achievements ,which is very rare for me!
We have won the battle for Super Earth in more ways than one and I hope that we continue to do so for a long time to come!
Overall an awesome game. I'm having a great time playing it.

From game braking bugs that have blue screened my PC, to audio issues with not selectable devices, it can be a pain. But this game is unmatched in its feild, I can not say I dont recomend it, one of the best communitys I have seen for a game, very good dev's who actively interact with the playerbase. It is just a blast, and this blast turns into a nuke with friends, I have laughed so much from this game, wether its getting squished by my friends drop pod for the SEVENTH TIME in a match or saying watch out for the mines only for my friend to walk right into them while looking at the map. There is so much fun to be had. Get out there and protect Super Earth Helldiver!
